authorRole: Independent AI fixture author; not a human expert reviewer
authorIdentity: Separate delegated AI agent with blind contract-only task

independence.sourceRead: Only the original input contract supplied in the delegation was inspected for task content.

purpose: AI-generated holdout evidence for conservative release assessment, malformed graph handling, calendar CPM arithmetic, cost separation and process-control cross-checks. This is not industrial expert validation or certification evidence.
designRationale: Eighteen self-contained bundles include clean GO and valid CONDITIONAL controls to detect false positives; omitted manifests, unapproved or future approval, critical non-waivable rejection, expired and scope-mismatched concessions, unapproved changes, numeric override, evidence graph defects, schedule graph defects and PFMEA-Control Plan omissions exercise conservative failure paths. A calendar-only fork/join with an FS lag yields hand-calculated finish, float, slip and cost. No business-calendar or local-time assumptions are needed.

oracleInterpretation.findingCodes: Generic independent semantic labels, not implementation identifiers. Additional truthful findings are allowed. Empty findingCodes is intended only for the fully controlled clean GO case.
oracleInterpretation.reviewRequired: For schedule and PFMEA invalidity, REVIEW_REQUIRED denotes a visible actionable review/invalid conclusion rather than a mandated literal aggregate status. The contract does not prescribe an aggregate status token for those conditions; an implementation may use HOLD or a separate domain review state. It must not silently certify invalid conclusions.
oracleInterpretation.hold: For missing manifest and unresolved mandatory approval, HOLD denotes absence of release acceptance. A stricter non-release state is semantically equivalent.
oracleInterpretation.go: GO describes release evidence acceptance. Forecast slip and EAC variance are reported independently; the contract does not state they automatically change release evidence status.
oracleInterpretation.schedule: Dates are exclusive finish boundaries. Exact numeric expectations are asserted only for the clean two-day case and the explicit calendar fork/join. Critical path and float use the unconstrained network finish, not SOP. Delay exposure is excluded from EAC.
oracleInterpretation.citations: PFMEA-Control Plan findings must identify the relevant input record rows. Parser-supplied provenance cannot be authored as trusted provenance by this fixture author.

sharing: Authoring completed before notifying the implementing agent. Initial completion notice contains only directory, count and SHA256 values, with no expected outcomes.
